payload.campaign: uuid — the campaign whose library takes the sound; one the product does not hold is refused, 404
payload.name: string — the sound's name, trimmed; required
payload.tags: string[] — normalised per SoundTag@1: trimmed, lowercased, blanks and duplicates dropped, order kept
payload.volume: number — the sound's own volume in percent, 0 to 100, stored as a fraction of 1; absent, full volume (100)
payload.file: string — the sound file's path; required
